_about: Registry of published swipe books (Tiffany Oct 30 2:45am: she never swipes the same product twice). Key = the book's collection key D.col. book_gate.py [g] FAILS a new book whose D.col (or product handle) is already here with votes/completed, unless it is that same book being updated (--update-of <url>). Every task that publishes a swipe book adds its entry here in the same commit.

poppins-mat-in-tubeswipe.product: Poppins mat (Oh My Mahjong, mat in tube)
